book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Me moxo neil wou xel, “A neil wou xam zonghek, xel valu wei toungale inye eno tyek se balwou meyeing qe ka xel gyei tete lalei wei Anutu xe yo nam is nikanzek bole.”
Yesu neing pekwi bange
Ka bouk limti la veil le woyom Yesu qou Petele, Jems me Yoan is xow de qou lal me lek lukendu vaxading ti, wei xel venaxow la toundei yo. De nanghei inyei eno moxo neing pekwi wou lal mend.
E xe teimb on teltyip me wou teleing ghanaw eti yeiw lek tembuing sapa wei embei sekweyexe xel xe teimb bo pus o.
Woyom Eliya me Mose lam nale nanghei inyon wou lal mend me di luk is Yesu.
Petele neil wou Yesu, “Putoung, inye nimza bei xey a toumendei inye. Om xa bei sakev xomek sel yayal, ti wou wang, ti wou Mose de ti wou Eliya.”
(Moxo neil ambei nyon en se woulek bei na neil vati, en nambei lal yaleeng mouyo.)
Woyom laxap ti lam me li tenu zeyi xel, de vya ti lam eivek laxap me neil: “Tine inye a Neung Moux, e tiwei a laleing vind o. Xam a mi ngo e vya!”
Se wo lululek, en gyeik ingwei lal yei e vivekwou eno lal se lox yei xelti no is xel, qe Yesu venaxow.
Ka xel di loum axone veil lukendu, Yesu wong qayeeng nikanzek wou lal bei kandek lal se neil wou xelti en vati wei lal yei yo, qe ka Xomaxoneing Neu Moux qandi lek veil meyeing bole.
Lal zeimaxoun qayeeng on wou lal venaxow me di luklek, “Qandieing veil meyeing ne inye qes ambei nya?”
Woyom xel teling e, “Nambei nya putoung wei petieing o neil embei Eliya e nam atax?”
Yesu neil elox, “Neing o, Eliya lam atax, me menyex wou lul dalus lox eivek no. Ekom qayeeng nge eno xel byex eivek xoulek bei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux na qou myavanei ngandoung me xel pesek e?
Ekom a neil wou xam, Eliya vena lam o, me xel wong vati wei xel wou naleind en o dalus wou e. Nambei ingwei xel byex eivek xoulek en e yo.”
Yak ghavis tiwei laweeng nilul eno wo nimza
Gyeik xel loum wou xel betiyeing valu, xel yei xel qendu ngandoung ti vivekwou xel me xel putoung wei petieing o di pyalek ama is xel.
Se denlek en xomaxoneing dalus yei Yesu, xel etek me veimyend me la neil bendiyeing wou e.
Moxo teling, “Xam ghe di pyalek ama is xel en vati?”
Moux ti eivek qendu yon lewexe, “Putoung, a qou neung moux me na lam wou wang, en laweeng wei myatueing o ti nale eivek e om se mi luk.

Gyeik ingwei embei zeimaxoun e nikanzek, eno mi nex e lek tembuing. Moxo myapeleis mi taw lam lox e mya, de newou mi wo nyiknyik me mema vaxa mi wo nikanzek. A teling wou wa xe xel betiyeing bei xel a tiy laweeng nilul on na veil e ekom xel se teyei.”
Yesu neil elox, “O xam wei gweimbeeng ne xam xe wongeingis eno ma. Tyek a mi mendei is xam bouk vamva? Tyek a qalei nimaying wei xam o bouk vamva? Qou yak on me lam inye wou ay.”
Om xel qou moxo me lam wou e. Gyeik laweeng on yei Yesu, eno se wo lululek en bimexe yak on la wo peleipelei lek tembuing me myapeleis di taw lam lox e mya.
Yesu teling wou yak on ma, “Moxo mi wong ambei nye teyei lek bouk vamva?” E lewexe, “Gyeik ingwei e nanghei yak o.
Inye mi nex ela eivek nenyex o memiing lumama bei nyeis e mey. Ekom wangwei wa teyei being bo lulti wou, yon wa pyanaleim en xa me devind xa.”
Yesu neil, “Nambei nya wang neimbei ‘Wangwei wa teyei nei?’ Ond lul dalus ena teyei lek wou eti yeiw wei mi wongis o.”
Se wo lululek en ghavis on ma taxe lox, “A wongis o ekom a laleing wo yuw om wa devind ay!”

Gyeik Yesu yei xel qendu tiyon di veimyend me lam wou xel ne, moxo luk niseikeing wou laweeng nilaxes on. De moxo neil, “Wa laweeng wei nenya qatu me myatueing, a peti wang bei wang nam myayaing veil e dom wa seng nox me na eivek e no.”
Laweeng on nyayek me bimexe e niseikeing dom la myayaing veil e. Yak on xok ambei xel meyeing, om xel ngenong on neil embei, “Moxo mey o.”
Ekom Yesu zeim e mema me e nale lek vaxa, me nale ghey.
Ka Yesu lox xomek lalei, e xe xel betiyeing teling wou e xupekeing, “Nambei nya xa se teyeimbei tiy e na myayaing?”
E neil elox, “Lul ambei nye eno teyeimbei nam myayaing en zeimeing mema tixemou ne.”
Yesu neil e xe meyeing teyei luyuw
Xel ghanaw beyeeng tiyon me la lox Galili. Yesu embei xelti se boulek ingwei xel toundei ghei yo,

en nambei e di teyoxe e xe xel betiyeing. Moxo neil wou xel, “Tyek xel a toung Xomaxoneing Neu Moux na eivek xomaxoneing memend. Tyek xel nyeis e mey, deka bouk yal ena veil, woyom moxo tyek qandi lek.”
Ekom xel se woulek vati wei e neil o qes de xel yaleeng om xel se teling e en inyon.
Eti wo lei ngandoung?
Xel lam tyip Kapenaom. Gyeik e la eivek xomek woy, moxo teling xel, “Xam ghe di lam wou sakwaing eno xam ghe pyalek ama en vati?”
Ekom xel toundei kanzek en nambei xel di lam wou sakwaing eno xel pyalek ama bei eti eivek xel eno wo lei ngandoung.
Yesu dei tembuing me taxe xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw on lam me neil, “Wangwei xelti embei na mya, ond e nam ti yusayang, me bong ambei xukxe wei xel dalus o.”
Moxo qou yak tika me wong e nale eivek xel senghoing. Dom qava e eivek mema me neil wou xel,

“Eti lalei vind yak ambei nye wei wongis me qou e eno qou a manghalus en a leing yond lalei vind me qou ay, me eti lalei vind ay me qou ay eno lalei se vind a maxow me qou ay, qe qou tambiy tiwei wong a lam o.”
Eti yeiw wei se pesek xey eno inyon xe xe
Yoan neil, “Putoung, xa xei moux ti di tiy xel memo nangya wa leim om xa neil wou bei e tip, en nambei tambiy ne se mi betiy xey.”
Yesu neil, “Xam se neimbei e tip, en eti yeiw wei di wong lulvako eivek a leing eno tyek se neil nilul ti lek ay.
En eti yeiw wei se pesek xey, eno inyon xe xe.
A neil wou xam zonghek, eti bong mayamya memiing ti wou xam en a leing, en inye nambei xam on Kilisi xe, yond tyek se teyei bei saing e xe xouveing.
Vati wong sewokeing mi tyip

“Me wangwei tambiy ti embei bong yakyak on ti wei wongis ay eno detei en sewokeing, on Anutu tyek bong myaveweeng ngandoung ghanaw veil, nambei ingwei xel tup qakous ngandoung e vivekwou e kwa me banex ena eivek mamileeng o.
Wangwei wa memam bo wa detei en sewokeing, on wa qateiv veil. Inye nimza bei wang na eivek mapieing is memam tixemou de is mema yuw eno tyek wang na eivek nenyex wei se mi mey yo.
[Nanghei inyon eno xel xe meii se mi mey me nenyex se mi mey.]

Me wangwei wa vaxam bo wa detei en sewokeing nei, on wa qateiv veil. Inye nimza bei wang na eivek mapieing is vaxam tixemou, de wa vaxam yuw eno tyek xel banex wang na eivek beyeeng wei nenyex luta yo.
[Nanghei inyon eno xel xe meii se mi mey me nenyex se mi mey.]

Me wangwei wa mamghalus bo wa detei en sewokeing nei, yond qepei elam myayaing. Inye nimza bei wang na eivek tete lalei wei Anutu is mam tixemou dom se yuw, on tyek banex wang na eivek beyeeng wei nenyex luta yo,
nanghei inyon eno

content.text: “‘xel meii mi byex xomaxoneing neing eno se mi tip,
me nenyex se mi mey o.’

content: Nenyex tyek detei lek xomaxoneing sapa me bong xel bo vako nambei xel mi selew lulul en mileeng o.
“Mileeng on nimza, ekom wangwei e xe nenyeing on nama eno tyek wang teyei bei bong enox bo nenyeing ambei nya no? Xam ghe teyei lek mileeng om tyek xam mendei lalei vevopeing is ama.”
